label: Watermark
description: Stamp your logo or wordmark onto any image or video — 9 positions or an exact m0 rect, ratio-true sizing, opacity control. Point it at a folder for one watermarked output per input. (Free tier adds the m0saic QR at bottom-right — pick a different corner to avoid overlap.)

sourceIds.label: Source(s)
sourceIds.description: Media to watermark — pick a folder, one or more files, or drag-and-drop. One watermarked output per input.

mode.label: Mode
mode.description: Watermark mode. "static" bakes it in; "adaptive" and "page" land in later phases.

content.label: Content
content.description: What the watermark shows: your logo image, a text wordmark, or both ("lockup", later phase).

image.label: Logo
image.description: Logo image file — PNG with transparency recommended.

imageDark.label: Logo (dark)
imageDark.description: Dark-background logo variant, crossfaded in over dark scenes (adaptive mode; later phase).

textColorOnLight.label: Text Color (on light)
textColorOnLight.description: Wordmark color over bright regions (adaptive mode; later phase).

variant.label: Variant
variant.description: "auto" follows scene luminance (bright scenes get the on-light artwork, dark scenes your primary styling); "single" always uses the primary artwork. Auto degrades to single when no luma probe is available.

windowing.label: Windowing
windowing.description: "always" keeps the watermark on (entrance fade); "windows" fades it in and out over timed appearances whose count scales with clip duration.

coverageOverride.label: Coverage
coverageOverride.description: Windowed mode: fraction of the clip the watermark is on-screen (overrides the duration tier).

fadeMs.label: Fade (ms)
fadeMs.description: Fade in/out duration at entrance and window boundaries, ms.

crossfadeMs.label: Crossfade (ms)
crossfadeMs.description: Light↔dark crossfade duration at scene brightness changes (always-on auto), ms.

lumaThreshold.label: Luma Threshold
lumaThreshold.description: Region luma (0..255) at/above which a scene counts as bright.

minGapMs.label: Min Gap (ms)
minGapMs.description: Minimum gap between windowed appearances, ms.

lumaByInput.label: Luma By Input
lumaByInput.description: Override hatch: per-input region-luminance results. Normally the template pulls these itself via ctx.analysis — set this only to bypass the probe (agents, tests).

lockupLayout.label: Lockup Layout
lockupLayout.description: Lockup arrangement: wordmark beside the logo or beneath it.

angleDeg.label: Angle
angleDeg.description: Pattern rotation angle, degrees clockwise (negative = up-slope).

tileGapRatio.label: Tile Gap
tileGapRatio.description: Gap between pattern instances, fraction of min(width, height).

stagger.label: Stagger
stagger.description: Offset alternate pattern rows by half the pitch (brick layout).

maxTiles.label: Max Tiles
maxTiles.description: Hard cap on pattern instances (the gap grows to satisfy it).

debugLayout.label: Debug Layout
debugLayout.description: Dev: verify the watermark's layout contract and render a violation card instead of a broken layout.

sizeRatio.label: Size
sizeRatio.description: Watermark width as a fraction of the size basis — match it to your brand assets.

sizeBasis.label: Size Basis
sizeBasis.description: Which canvas dimension the size ratio measures against.

marginRatio.label: Margin
marginRatio.description: Margin from the canvas edges, as a fraction of min(width, height).

layoutM0.label: Layout (m0)
layoutM0.description: Escape hatch: an m0 layout resolving to exactly ONE frame — the watermark is placed in that rect (content keeps its aspect, contain-fit). Overrides Position/Size/Margin.

imageOutputFormat.label: Image Format
imageOutputFormat.description: Image outputs: match each input's container (jpg stays jpeg, else png), or force one.
